englishNaturalness.evidence: The classmates perform an explicit object-naming task, so asking what a familiar object is has a reason. The English has been reviewed as short beginner utterances, not as a claim of authentic unscripted dialogue.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Checked every turn translation and all option explanations against the intended English meaning, speaker, object and communicative act.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: The short response model explains contractions and singular object naming.

transferQuality.evidence: A04 contrasts objects with a clear referent; A06 reverses the information gap and asks the learner to produce the question. Evidence is same-session bounded recall, not a proficiency certificate.

overallCoherence.evidence: The classmates perform an explicit object-naming task, so asking what a familiar object is has a reason. Teaching, selection feedback and the terminal task retain the Lesson outcome and played role.

learnerExperience.evidence: Static flow review: optional help, typed fallback and per-option explanations reduce dead ends. No real microphone, perception or learner test was performed.

limitations: Real learner outcomes and delayed retention have not been measured.
Generated audio has not received a perceptual/prosody review.
Exact-match retrieval recognizes bounded patterns; valid alternative English can fall outside its answer list.
